entities.name: Dennis Schröder
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dennis Malik Schröder is a German professional basketball player for the Cleveland Cavaliers of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He previously played for SG Braunschweig and Phantoms Braunschweig in Germany, before joining the Atlanta Hawks for his first five seasons in the NBA. He is the sole owner of his German hometown team, Basketball Loewen Braunschweig of the Basketball Bundesliga, and had been the majority shareholder of the team since 2018.
